parsed.reason: The reason correctly reads the item as a work 1:1 with a colleague, which supports the adult verdict. The rule that an adult sharing a child's name is still an adult backs it up. Two flaws keep it from a 5. First, 'her' assigns a gender the item does not support. Second, it rests on the surname, which is weak evidence because children have surnames too, instead of the '1:1' and '(design)' work context that actually shows this is an adult.
